claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BML-190 is an aminoalkylindole CB2 inverse agonist that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells through CB2 signaling; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a physicochemical/lysosomotropic or nonspecific aminoalkylindole effect rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
